title: Optimal Global Sobolev Estimates for Fractional Dirichlet Problems in Bounded Lipschitz Domains
summary: Let $n\geq2$, $s\in(0,1)$, and let $Ω\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ be a bounded Lipschitz domain. In this paper, we establish optimal global Sobolev estimates for the fractional Dirichlet problem \begin{equation*} \left\{\begin{aligned} (-Δ)^su&=f & & \text{in}\ \ Ω, u&=0 & & \text{in}\ \ \mathbb{R}^n\setminusΩ. \end{aligned}\right. \end{equation*} More precisely, for any given $t\in[s,\min\{2s,\,s+1/2\})$, we prove that there exists a small positive constant $η=η(n,s,t,Ω)$ such that the following holds.
